context: Walk Her Home: to the 34th St subway.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: In Port-au-Prince my mother walked me home. Now you do. Strange world.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule eighteen: nobody walks Eighth Avenue alone after two.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Goodnight. Lock the door. Count your money in the morning.
